whenToUse: Messages, feedback and other free text answers that run over several lines
Labeled long text fields with a hint under the box, an error state or a disabled state
Profile bios that count characters toward a limit and grow as the user types

whenNotToUse.when: A comment or prompt box with buttons or a live count inside its border
A modal that asks for a note along with reasons to tick, such as a churn survey
A complete page of fields, such as a support ticket or a profile edit, saved together

agentNotes: `Textarea` grows with its text through `field-sizing-content` with no height cap, and Chromium ignores `rows`; set min-h and max-h classes
Only `aria-invalid` on `Textarea` turns its border red, in every style; a data-invalid flag on `Field` leaves the border as it was
